title: Working-set window
purpose: Explain working set as distinct pages in the lastΔ references, using exact10-reference examples.
requiredChecks: Δ is10 references; each of two windows has exactly10 values.
Working set is distinct pages, not count of all references; arrows/brackets denote the past window ending at each time.
alt: Working-set examples with a ten-reference window: five distinct pages at t1 and two at t2
prompt: Create a NEW original English technical educational diagram. White background, crisp large navy sans-serif text, flat blue/teal shapes, minimal clean connectors, generous margins, no logos or watermark, no decorative or traced textbook artwork. TITLE "Working-set window". Subtitle exactly "Δ = 10 most recent references". Two independent example rows. Upper row heading "Window ending at t1", with EXACTLY10 equal cells LEFT-TO-RIGHT: 2,6,1,5,7,7,7,7,5,1. Under this row text exactly "WS(t1) = {1, 2, 5, 6, 7}". Lower row heading "Window ending at t2", EXACTLY10 equal cells: 3,4,3,4,4,3,4,3,4,4. Under this row text exactly "WS(t2) = {3, 4}". For each row add a thin bracket spanning ALL ten cells labeled "Δ" and a time marker at its RIGHT edge labeled t1 or t2. Arrows/brackets must indicate the immediately preceding window, not a future window. Alternate blue/teal for page group distinction, but do not change digits or merge repeated cells. Footer exactly "Working set = distinct pages in the window". These are explicitly illustrative windows, not a measured trace. All braces, commas and digits mandatory.
